lines: Gainwell's carries jumped to 14.7 per game over the last three games, up from 7.0 on the season, while his snap share stayed near 39%.
He's averaging 81.3 rushing yards and 11.1 PPR points per game over that stretch, but only 1.3 targets a game, so the passing work is light.
The coach said he'll keep a growing share in a 1A/1B split with Bucky Irving. Wk 11 is at DET, 31st-most PPR points allowed to RBs.
